name: ui/input
title: Input
summary: The registry input: a native <input> with the pill radius and a 48px target on every pointer. Every attribute except class passes through.

props.name: ...attributes
props.description: Passed through: name, type, value, required, autocomplete, aria-*.

behaviour: Renders exactly the attributes given, plus data-slot, data-portal and the classes.
aria-invalid styles the error state; the browser's own validity drives it, not a prop.

aria: The caller labels it (Label or aria-label).

theming.brandOverlay: The focus ring follows the brand's `--ring`. Nothing else changes.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

contract:
contract
  slot is "input"
  portal is "https://mzizi.dev/components/input"
  label is "Email"
  class contains "rounded-full"
end
